_comment: Chain id → the shared network registry of the workbench and ladder. `factory` is the official ModuleFactory proxy. `ladder` is the TankLadder of the season. null = not deployed yet. On a fresh local node, Deploy.s.sol creates the Factory proxy at nonce 2 of account 0. DeployLadder.s.sol then creates the ladder at nonce 9. An entry with `forkOf` is a local anvil fork of that chain: it takes the addresses of the forked entry (frontend/chain.js), and the port of its `rpc` is the port of the fork.
